verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud is a SaaS search platform with an MCP server, so issuing scoped API keys to agents is a fair question. The evidence pack never documents scoped, read-only or least-privilege credentials. The Secure Proxy, which hides the OpenAI key on the client side, is a different feature and earns no credit. The auto-configured MCP server is also described without any credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
